_about: Cyril Edwin Mitchinson Joad (1891-1953), English popular philosopher. He died in 1953, but every book here was published before 1930. Raw IA OCR: Essays in Common-Sense Philosophy (New York: Harcourt, Brace and Howe, 1920); Common-Sense Ethics (London: Methuen, first published 1921); Mind and Matter (Putnam, 1925); Matter, Life and Value (Oxford University Press, 1929). Project Gutenberg: Thrasymachus, or the future of morals (New York: Dutton, copyright 1926, first printing December 1925; PG 74315). Held: Introduction to Modern Philosophy (Oxford, 1924); both scans found are reprints of 1934 or later. US public domain. No uids minted.
